text: It is highly unlikely that Russia has fully secured Kostiantynivka Instead, it is assessed that Russia likely occupies approximately over half of the urban centre Open source reporting has identified incidents of Russian flag raising along the northern boundary of the city, but these are highly likely small infiltration groups rather than a consolidated force It is highly likely that Ukraine continues to defend the city, disrupting Russia’s ability to seize full control Continued Russian assaults on these cities will highly likely come at high cost for Russian forces
